rows: Place a Dirty or Damaged circuit in the process input.
Check that the corresponding server recipe is present.
Provide full batch energy and clear output slots.
Move the resulting clean board into the analyser.

blocks.text: A clean/already analysed board is not the dirty/damaged input this chamber expects.
